Asking because I'm from Europe so I'll have to wake up in the middle of the night haha My guess is cause hashrate is falling off fast but it could just be error Thanks, I'll keep monitoring. `Estimated Date 09.15.2022` Maybe related to my regional settings, but it should show "15.09.2022" or "09/15/2022"... That mixed up format is very irritating 😄 I think it changes auto based on your region. or perhaps it uses utc Not sure which we enabled for it typically from locale google and wen merge showing different numbers looks like google aligns with pretty much teh back of bordel window bordel and wenmerge are within half an hour, they'll continue to get closer to agreement link to bordel? Legal issues. CL teams change from software providers to trusted parties (that can be sued) https://bordel.wtf/ my current estimator is pretty aligned with bordel at this point (as we converge): ``` 15535468 | 15:46:20 | 9s ⏱ | 22% | 10.6 ⛽ | 0.04 🔥︁ | 0.02  | 63 txn | 786.7 Th | 13.11 M-GPU | 14.69 sec | 58728204 td | 27705 sec | Wed Sep 14 11:28:05 PM | 38ms | ``` Can yall push the merge up a few hours? Its happening past my bedtime. if you can convince half the miners to shutdown right now, you could delay for about ~7. 5 hours happy to fund some compute if others can assist for about $50,000 you could probably push it up 30m maybe 5m even i'm personally surprised hashrate is falling so fast today, after getting this far without hashrate dropping much perf hope they accept etc Mining pools have far weaker incentives to honor payouts after the merge. I can see the logic in getting paid out a bit early and shutting down. ahh that makes perfect sense, thanks Hashrate falling was inevitable, I'm surprised it didn't drop that much days before today agreed, i thought hashrate would have halved in the final 30 days some ppl were doom and glooming much larger cliff myself included 🔥 ultimately there's money in staying around, and they've already made the investment, i'd have been surprised if it was a huge drop well, value of a GPU drops a lot faster than can be made with it, post-merge, imo w3n m3r63 Avoiding rugpoolin If I'm only running a full node for RPC access lets say for `eth_blockNumber` calls, do I need to run a beacon node? or just execution client? Thanks in advance In summary, post-merge will beacon be required even for execution layer full nodes or everything remains the same?
